name: Status Update
summary: A short, repeatable report: overall status, progress since last time, metrics, risks and blockers, next steps and asks.
references: Common project management practice; see PMI, PMBOK Guide (1996 onward)
title_style: Status-first titles, under 10 words, e.g. 'On track: ...' or 'At risk: ...'.

sequence.purpose: What was done since last update.
What you need from the audience.

pitfalls: Hiding bad news below good news.
Activity lists with no status or outcome.
Blockers mentioned without a specific ask.

example.topic: A fictional web team's weekly checkout redesign update
outline: On track: checkout redesign ships in two weeks
Done: payment form and address step
Test pass rate up from 80% to 96%
At risk: tax rules for two regions still pending
Next: tax rules, final review, staged release
Need: legal sign-off on tax wording by Thursday
